question: What is the range (max minus min) of total quarterly revenue (summing all three product lines) across the four quarters?
description: Tier A / presentation-only attack: the y-axis top is set to 600, far past the true max stack total (~310), compressing all four bars' true 70/240 (~29%) range into the bottom half of the plot. Axis ticks are accurate for the widened range; stack order, data, and tooltips are unchanged. Technique: 'inappropriate_axis_range' (Misleading ChartQA arXiv:2503.18172, 'Manipulated Scale' category). A floor-truncation version (axis starting above 0) was considered and rejected: with a 3-way stack, any segment whose cumulative boundary falls below a raised floor renders off the visible axis (Hardware and part of Software sit below 200 in every quarter here), which would clip visibly broken rather than subtly mislead. True range is 70 (310-240); the compressed scale may bias a vision-reading model toward underestimating it.
